status: Proposed opening scene implementation copy; no childhood, Rider-history or permanent deputy-rank change. New Gantt voice recordings are not supplied by this file.
speaker: Tobias Gantt

messages.text: Gantt: Mind that tool case? Get it behind the brace. I need this door clear. Then come back here a moment.
Gantt: Much obliged. You working your passage, or just trying to get somewhere?
buttons: Trying to reach the next stop.
Does helping you come with wages?

messages.text: Gantt: Mercy can always use hands that finish a job. I can't promise you a place, but I can tell you who to ask.
Gantt: Then we're bound for the same stop. Mercy Crossing. Small place, but you'll find a roof and somebody who knows the roads.
Gantt: This one's a favor. The sheriff may have paid work when you arrive. I won't promise his money for him.

Gantt: Tobias Gantt. Rail marshal. Pritchard at Mercy expects my dispatch. If we get separated, will you put it in his hands?

It's a delivery, not an arrest. Keep it sealed. If somebody demands it, get yourself clear and tell the sheriff.
Gantt: Owen Pritchard. Mercy's sheriff. Green cabin above the road. He'll want what you actually saw, not what somebody talked you into believing.
Gantt: Thank you. I'll keep it with me for now. If I can't finish the journey, you know where it belongs. Nobody's asking you to die for a badge.
Gantt: Fair enough. Then if you see Pritchard, tell him I'm looking for him. You don't owe me more than you agreed to.
The case is secured. Continue the journey toward Mercy Crossing?
Gantt is dead. His dispatch still needs to reach Sheriff Pritchard at Mercy Crossing.

implementation_rules: Use the eleven exact property names and button indices agreed with the controller. These are captions, not a claim of recorded dialogue.
The ordinary tool-case interaction must visibly secure the case before ReadyDeparture describes it as secured.
All three motives express a current reason for traveling, not a fixed profession or childhood.
Record heard request, accepted request and declined request separately. A negative or stale message result records no new agreement.
WhoPritchard may return to RequestChoice once per ordinary activation; no automatic infinite dialogue loop.
Gantt retains the dispatch. Do not give the player a duplicate item, caps, deputy rank, faction membership or an early MQ01 pickup stage.
EarlyDeath is neutral player-facing narration, not speech from a corpse or proof of who killed him. Show it only after observing the original marshal dead.
ReadyDeparture is neutral narration. Keep any fade, sound or crash claim separate from this confirmation.
Pritchard's later new dialogue must distinguish an accepted promise from a declined or unheard request, and must not blame the wreck for an observed earlier death.
Preserve existing recorded Pritchard lines and their matching captions. New words require new matching recordings before voiced-playback claims.
